ROOT CAUSE: The chat’s Send File download button uses the original absolute path saved as `fp` and requests `/api/files/raw?path=…` ([chat.js](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/C-O4-luna/app/static/js/chat.js:3429)). The `/api/files/raw` endpoint serves that path directly and returns 404 when it no longer exists ([system.py](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/C-O4-luna/app/routes/system.py:276)). Archiving/removing the worker calls `remove_worktree`, which deletes that worktree ([manager.py](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/C-O4-luna/app/manager.py:1173), [workspace.py](/home/kesha/bench895/runs/C-O4-luna/app/workspace.py:2770)). So the link still points into the deleted worker checkout; a copy in the main checkout does not help because the URL is path-based, not a durable file ID or snapshot. This is distinct from `publish_artifact`, which snapshots content and has its own expiry.

Independent check: `git worktree remove --force <worker-worktree>` removes that path; requesting `/api/files/raw?path=<that-path>/<file>.docx` then returns 404, while the main-checkout copy remains accessible.
